posts.title: A Visit to Vietnam, Part 5 - We Visit Ninh Binh
posts.description: On our second day in Hanoi we got an early start heading south about sixty miles to the Ninh Binh area. Our primary destination was the river trip via small sampan on the Ngo Dong river at Tam Coc. Guide Mike and our driver arrived a bit before 8 A.M. and we headed out of town on the expressway CT101. posts.title: A Visit to Vietnam, Part 4 - The Sidewalks of Old Town in Hanoi
posts.description: At the end of our first day in Hanoi, we headed out to explore a bit of the Old Town neighborhood where we were staying at the Silk Path Hotel. We turned right and headed up Hang Bong Street toward Hoan Kiem Lake. We hadn't gone very far when we noticed a Circle K convenience store.
